title: Atlas Core local automation security assessment
scope: Guarded local inbox processing, scheduled verified backups, official SDK status, private Gateway authorization, and localhost operator visibility

approved_targets: Synthetic disposable databases and inbox fixtures
Loopback operator and Gateway test services
prohibited_actions: Connect live company or vendor systems

trust_boundaries: Configured inbox to bounded file parser
Validated connector record to registered industry adapter
Automation status to authenticated private Gateway
data_flows: Regular JSONL, NDJSON, or CSV file to transactional import and Cartographer
Company Memory to locally verified SQLite recovery point
Payload-free automation receipt to SDK, operator, and authorized Gateway

threats.name: Untrusted or oversized inbox input
threats.control: Regular-file check, extension allowlist, 5 MiB bound, UTF-8 and structural validation, adapter validation, transaction rollback

threats.name: Overlapping unattended runners
threats.control: Exclusive per-database O_EXCL lock released in a finally block

threats.name: Sensitive payload copied into operational telemetry
threats.control: Receipts contain identifiers, checksums, counts, outcomes, and bounded errors but no record payload

threats.name: Unattended deletion of all recovery points
threats.control: Automatic pruning defaults off, requires explicit configuration, and enforces keep_last of at least two

threats.name: Remote filesystem disclosure
threats.control: Gateway requires global backup permission and redacts config_path and state_directory

findings.finding: A process crash can leave runner.lock behind; automatic stale-lock deletion is intentionally not implemented because PID reuse makes silent reclamation unsafe.

validation: Python compileall and browser JavaScript syntax checks passed
Installed three-wheel automation, SDK, Gateway, recovery, and retention smoke passed
Live localhost Automation view rendered verified receipts with zero browser errors and no horizontal overflow
residual_risk: No operating-system service supervisor or stale-lock recovery procedure is installed.
No approved encrypted off-device backup destination exists.
Provider-specific authentication, production identity, TLS certificate lifecycle, monitoring, and incident operations remain unconfigured.
This assessment is implementation evidence, not a compliance certification.
